slides.title: Why Geometric Flow Matching?
text: Why Geometric Flow Matching?
For protein structure prediction,
data lives in (non-Euclidean)
Riemannian manifold.
• Backbone is represented as elements of 𝑆𝐸 3 0 ,
i.e., local orientations around 𝐶1 atoms.
• Sidechains are represented as elements of 𝑆𝑂 2 0×3 ,
i.e., torsion angles.

slides.title: Why Geometric Flow Matching?
text: Why Geometric Flow Matching?
Almost all structure design models follow the framework of AlphaFold2.
Among them, there are several flow-based models.
• Flow-based : FoldFlow, FrameFlow
• Improved flow-based : Proteus, MultiFlow, PepFlow, PPFlow
